tools.name: slack_search_public
tools.description: Searches messages and files in public channels only. No user consent required.

query.description: Search query with Slack search modifiers.

only_my_channels.description: Restrict results to channels you belong to.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous result.

tools.name: slack_search_public_and_private
tools.description: Searches messages and files in all channels, including private channels, DMs and group DMs. Requires user consent.

query.description: Search query with Slack search modifiers.

only_my_channels.description: Restrict results to channels you belong to.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous result.

tools.name: slack_search_channels
tools.description: Finds public and private channels by name or description.

tools.name: slack_search_users
tools.description: Finds users by name, email or role.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Reads a channel's message history, around a point in time for context.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Gets the full thread context for a threaded message.

tools.name: slack_read_user_profile
tools.description: Gets a user's profile details, custom fields and status from their user ID.

tools.name: slack_read_file
tools.description: Reads the contents of a file surfaced by a file search.

tools.name: slack_list_channel_members
tools.description: Lists the user IDs of a channel's members.

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to any type of conversation (channel, thread, DM or group DM). Body accepts standard markdown.

tools.name: slack_send_message_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft message for the user to review before sending. Body accepts standard markdown.

tools.name: slack_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedules a message to post at a future time.

post_at.description: Unix timestamp, at least 2 minutes and at most 120 days in the future.

tools.name: slack_create_canvas
tools.description: Creates and shares a Slack canvas, a formatted document written in Canvas-flavored Markdown.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message.

tools.name: slack_get_reactions
tools.description: Reads the existing reactions on a message.

tools.name: slack_get_file_upload_url
tools.description: Step 1 of file upload: returns a signed upload URL and a file ID to POST the file bytes to.

tools.name: slack_complete_file_upload
tools.description: Step 2 of file upload: finalizes the upload by file ID and can share the file to a channel with a message.
